data.content_ref: inline:The mechanism garbage-collects orphaned unmerged leaves that are not ancestors of any evidence node. After a crash with no terminal record, a fully-written evidence node may exist in the DAG but not yet appear in the durably recorded set of merged evidence nodes. Under the protocol’s own GC rule, that node is an unmerged leaf without an ancestor relationship in the last durable snapshot, so reclamation will garbage-collect it, silently displacing completed evidence that was present in storage but not yet merged.
